findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_reset_timeline" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Dated record of verified Codex usage-limit resets and related announcements (boosts, unlocks, credits), newest first, each with its source URL." → after: "Codex reset history: dated record of verified Codex usage-limit resets and banked reset grants (group credits), newest first, each with its source URL."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
